name: balerion-cli
observations: Slash commands return text strings via CommandContext, which cannot trigger interactive Ink UI components. To open interactive UI (e.g., ModelPicker with arrow navigation) from a slash command, add a callback to CommandContext and wire it through REPL.tsx. The /model command originally returned static text while the interactive picker was only accessible via Ctrl+M. When adding new interactive slash commands, always update CommandContext type, the command handler, REPL.tsx context construction, and test fixtures with the new callback field.
